name: Sakai Chemical Industry Co., Ltd.
summary: Sakai Chemical Industry Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells chemical industrial products in Japan, Asia, North America, Europe, the Middle East, and internationally. The company offers barium and strontium salt products; and zinc oxide for rubber, paints, plastics, electronic materials, cosmetics, and heat-dissipation materials. It also provides plastic additives, such as metallic soaps, hydrotalcite, and flame retardants, as well as calcium/zinc-based composite stabilizers; catalysts comprising De-NOx/De-DXN catalysts, hydrogenation catalysts, titanium catalysts for polyester polymerization, titanium dioxide for catalyst carriers, and catalysts for raw material…
